name: devloop
description: First-principles iterative development loop: build -> commit -> deploy (staging/local only, never production) -> adversarial black-box subagent review -> repeat until 100% -> cleanup and report.
skillInstructions:
devloop tool mapping for Kimi Code:

- When the skill says to ask the user or present multiple-choice options, call Kimi Code's `AskUserQuestion` tool with 1 question and 2-4 concrete options, recommended option first suffixed with `(Recommended)`.
- When the skill says to maintain a task list (`todo_write` / `TaskCreate` / `TodoWrite`), use Kimi Code's `TodoList` tool.
- When the skill says to spawn a review subagent (`run_subagent` / `Task tool` / `subagent_general` / `general-purpose`), use Kimi Code's `Agent` tool with `subagent_type: "coder"`: paste the fully filled review prompt into `prompt`, provide a short `description`, and wait for the report before continuing (do not run it in background).
- Use Kimi Code's `Read`, `Write`, `Edit`, `Bash`, `Grep`, `Glob`, `FetchURL`, `WebSearch` tools by their actual exposed names for file search, content search, URL fetch, and web search.

interface.shortDescription: Iterative dev loop with adversarial subagent review, until 100%
interface.longDescription: First-principles build, commit, deploy to staging or local (never production), adversarial black-box review by a subagent, iterate until the review scores 100%, then clean up and report an iteration table.
